title: Implement native macOS minibar projection

namingDeviation.reason: Task brief explicitly authorized these names ('names may align with current architecture'). The status item is a ~15-line member of MinibarWindowController rather than a separate file, because a second controller for one NSStatusItem would be indirection without a decision. No 'Caret' prefix ships in product source, consistent with the brand boundary in DESIGN.md 9.2.

defectsFoundByRealQA: Collapsed panel measured 360x88 instead of 360x56: Auto Layout content grew the window past the contract. Fixed by pinning contentMinSize/contentMaxSize to the contract size and moving the collapsed single line inline into the one 44pt header row. A regression test now pins both. Re-measured: 360x56 exactly.

cancelOperation was declared on the NSObject controller, which is not a responder, so Escape would never have fired. Moved onto MinibarPanel, which forwards to the pure MinibarMode rule. Re-verified on the real panel: 560x220 -> 360x56 with no outbound command.

adversarialProbes.malformed_json: truncated JSON and a badly typed line both surface ! 오류 on the real panel while retaining the last known line and timer; no crash; the next authoritative snapshot recovers (manual/07). The driver additionally covers non-JSON, wrong field types and a malformed batch.
adversarialProbes.offline_stop: Stop while the socket is down emits nothing (driver scenario stop-while-idle-emits-nothing and the transport's online guard); Stop is truthfully disabled outside live/starting.
adversarialProbes.repeated_stop: 5 rapid real clicks -> exactly one stopCapture frame on the wire (manual/05); spam-across-reconnect also emits exactly one (driver).
adversarialProbes.foreign_adopted_server: the launcher adopted the healthy fixture session instead of spawning a second Bun (launcher log: '이미 실행 중인 Meeting Slides 서버를 사용합니다'), and owned nothing; Todo-10's typed portOccupiedByForeignServer path is unchanged.
adversarialProbes.reconnect: socket dropped mid-capture -> ↻ 연결 끊김 — 재연결 중 with the timer basis and known line retained, then restored by the authoritative snapshot; sampled at 10ms granularity (manual/06b).
adversarialProbes.off_display_frame: a saved frame at (90000,90000) is rejected by the >=50%-visible rule and falls back to the deterministic default 1136,856,360x56 (manual/08).
adversarialProbes.repeated_interruption: Todo-10's ServerLifecycle is unchanged and still terminates at most once; the launcher now quits through applicationShouldTerminate, which runs the same handle(.quit) effects exactly once.
adversarialProbes.screen_capture_compatibility: EXACT RESULT, NO CLAIM: the minibar IS captured by screencapture, a public capture API. No exclusion API is used; NSWindow.SharingType.none is documented as legacy and unhonored. No UI, source or doc string claims screen-share exclusion; rg over macos/*.swift finds no sharingType or screen-share text (manual/09).
adversarialProbes.generated_binaries: the suite builds into mkdtemp and removes it in afterAll; the temp app bundle, temp project, fixture server, app defaults and every helper file were deleted; no listener on 8899 and no orphan process remain (manual/12).
adversarialProbes.symlink_side_effect: the temp-dir build repointed the repo 'Meeting Slides.app' symlink (known Todo-10 risk); detected and restored to $HOME/Applications/Meeting Slides.app in the same turn, verified twice (manual/01, manual/12).
adversarialProbes.flaky_tests: no sleep, poll or timing dependency in the seam; compile and run happen once in beforeAll; async behavior is modeled as ordered event lists and `now` is injected. The only waits are in the manual QA against a real GUI, which is not part of the test suite.
adversarialProbes.prompt_injection: N/A - all driver and fixture input is literal and authored in this task.

risks: scripts/build-app.sh still repoints the repository 'Meeting Slides.app' symlink whenever MEETING_SLIDES_APP_DIR is overridden. It was restored here, but Todo 17 should make that update conditional on building into the canonical install dir.
The installed $HOME/Applications/Meeting Slides.app was intentionally NOT rebuilt, so the shipped bundle still contains the pre-minibar binary until Todo 17 runs.

The launcher now sets NSApplication activation policy .regular and runs an AppKit run loop, so the app keeps a Dock tile while the minibar lives. This preserves the documented Dock identity, but Todo 17 should confirm the LSUIElement=false choice is still what the product wants now that a persistent ambient surface exists.

The minibar is visible to public screen-capture APIs (manual/09). This is recorded as the exact result; if the product later wants any narrower statement, Todo 17's per-application matrix must authorize it.

windowDidMove/windowDidResize persist the frame with displayId 0 rather than the resolved display id. Restoration is still correct because resolveFrame re-derives the host display from the saved rect, but the stored id is not meaningful and should be either populated or dropped in a later pass.

The AppKit shell is exercised by real manual QA and swiftc typecheck, not by automated GUI tests. Its thinness is enforced structurally (source assertions) plus the pure projection's 47 tests; a GUI regression would be caught by Todo 17/19 manual QA rather than by bun test.
